agents/comment-sicko.md.why: Reads why from ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/... instead of running /why, since that skill is user-only on Claude Code.

agents/flatpaper-agent.md.why: Renamed from poteto-agent and rewritten to read flatpaper-mode's SKILL.md and its Principles index before any work.

skills/architect/SKILL.md.why: Reads arena from its SKILL.md file because arena is user-only here. The model can invoke architect itself, per the substitution rule that drops its disable-model-invocation key.

skills/arena/SKILL.md.why: Tracks phases with TaskCreate, takes runners and the cross-family judge from the `arena runners` and `arena cross-judge pool` roles in models.json, runs Codex seats through codex-run.sh with the judge read-only, isolates repo-writing runners in worktrees, hands the graft fold to a fresh delegate when the arena runs inside a step that delegates implementation, and links principle skills by path.

skills/automate-me/SKILL.md.why: Authors through skill-creator, looks for mode skills one level under .claude/skills (Claude Code does not load nested ones), reads transcripts from ~/.claude/projects on the `history explorers` role, and fits AskUserQuestion's 2-4 options and multiSelect.

skills/benchmark-checklist/SKILL.md.why: Links the Perf issue and Hillclimb playbooks by path, since playbooks are files inside flatpaper-mode, not skills.

skills/blast-radius/SKILL.md.why: Reads unslop and arena from their SKILL.md files first, since they are user-only and cannot be invoked.

skills/figure-it-out/SKILL.md.why: Loads Claude Code's deferred task tools before opening the task list, and reads architect, show-me-your-work, and the principle skills by path because they are user-only.

skills/flatpaper-help/SKILL.md.why: Rewritten as flatpaper-stack's own help: the plugin-prefixed command catalog, the Claude Code setup path through models.md, which skills load from the user's words, and what the Cursor adaptation dropped.

skills/flatpaper-mode/SKILL.md.why: Opens the task list first, routes sessions through the SessionStart hook, moves model and effort choice into references/spawning.md, adds project playbooks, keeps the review gate closed without an independent reviewer, requires a reviewer who agrees before a reply says "fixed", keeps the chat running a playbook off product files in a step that delegates implementation, runs Codex roles through scripts/codex-run.sh, which adds the worker.md line to every Codex seat, and drops upstream's Opus and Fable model routing.

skills/flatpaper-mode/playbooks/autopilo.why: Uses gh for every PR (the Origin forge is dropped), runs each owner as a local worktree Agent instead of a cloud VM, and keeps the trail store at ~/.claude/orchestrate/<program>/.

skills/flatpaper-mode/playbooks/babysit..why: Uses gh only (no Origin forge), finds watch-pr inside the flatpaper-mode folder, and triages any review bot, since bugbot-triage.md is excluded.

skills/flatpaper-mode/playbooks/eval.md.why: Reads candidate transcripts from ~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session-id>/subagents/ instead of Cursor's agent-transcripts directory.

skills/flatpaper-mode/playbooks/feature..why: Step 5 wires the local run like the production environment and names what the evidence leaves out, and a short path skips steps 1, 2, 3 and 7 for user-decided changes to a feature already built.

skills/flatpaper-mode/playbooks/opening-.why: Uses gh only (no Origin forge or Cursor PR tool) and the plugin-prefixed deslop command.

skills/flatpaper-mode/playbooks/pause-sa.why: Runs on a flatpaper-stack compaction notice as well as an explicit request, and still pauses under keep-going; upstream has no compaction hook. The resume note also records the work split, so delegated work stays delegated after a compaction.

skills/flatpaper-mode/playbooks/session-.why: Finds the prior transcript under ~/.claude/projects instead of Cursor's agent-transcripts directory, and drops cloud-agent URLs, which Claude Code has no equivalent for.

skills/flatpaper-mode/playbooks/shipping.why: Lands through gh only with fresh local worktree verifiers; the Origin forge path, including its merge-everything-below behavior, is dropped.

skills/flatpaper-mode/playbooks/worktree.why: Claude Code has no pinned chats or sidebar, so the keep set is the chats the user still uses or plans to resume; worktrees live under .claude/worktrees and the Cursor app-support reclaimer is dropped.

skills/flatpaper-mode/scripts/watch-pr/g.why: Narrows existing check-read assertions to the reported variant so upstream tests type-check with the new union.
Distinguishes confirmed absent checks from unavailable checks and rejects unreported head suites that require action or have not finished cleanly.

skills/flatpaper-mode/scripts/watch-pr/c.why: Explains that no checks requires 60 seconds of confirmation regardless of poll interval and that status-only can show an unconfirmed reading.

skills/flatpaper-mode/scripts/watch-pr/p.why: Confirms absence for the same PR head across at least 60 seconds with an injectable clock before ci-none, preserving history, mergeability, suite guards, and existing blockers in single, stack, and queued runs.

skills/flatpaper-mode/scripts/watch-pr/r.why: Distinguishes unconfirmed no-checks sightings in status, waiting, and timeout output from confirmed absence in status and READY output.

skills/flatpaper-mode/scripts/watch-pr/t.why: Models reported and absent checks as tagged unions, separates ci-unreported from ci-none readiness proof, and adds checks-unreported decisions and wait/timeout reasons without changing existing pending-check shapes.

skills/flatpaper-mode/scripts/worktree-a.why: Reads PR state from gh only and greps Claude Code transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/<slug>* (worktree sessions included) instead of Cursor's agent-transcripts with rg.

skills/interrogate/SKILL.md.why: Reads in-your-own-words and arena from their SKILL.md files since they are user-only, and takes adversaries from the `interrogate reviewers` role in models.json.

skills/ketchup-video/SKILL.md.why: Reads ketchup and bro from their files since they are user-only, and shares the rendered video instead of embedding it in a Cursor chat.

skills/ketchup/SKILL.md.why: Reads bro from its file since it is user-only, and draws visuals as inline-SVG artifacts or ASCII art instead of Cursor's /visualize.

skills/maintain-verification-skill/SKILL.why: Spawns each source-wave reader as an Explore subagent on the `how explorer` role, with model and effort per spawning.md.

skills/no-comments/SKILL.md.why: Spawns comment-sicko through Agent with model and effort from spawning.md, and reads architect from its file since it is user-only.

skills/principle-explain-the-number/SKIL.why: Reads benchmark-checklist from its file before judging any number, since that skill is user-only.

skills/recall/SKILL.md.why: Reads Claude Code transcripts at ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl, fans out Explore subagents and general-purpose investigators on the `history explorers` role, and reads unslop by path.

skills/reflect/SKILL.md.why: Finds the transcript at ~/.claude/projects/<project>/${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID}.jsonl, with a fallback to the newest matching transcript in that folder, and protects skills under ~/.claude/plugins/cache/.

skills/setup-flatpaper-stack/SKILL.md.why: Writes ~/.claude/flatpaper-stack/models.md from models.json roles and budgets instead of the Cursor pstack-models.mdc rule, and maps a codex value to a codex-run.sh seat; its template fence is generated by scripts/stamp-models.mjs.

skills/show-me-your-work/SKILL.md.why: Reads the run's transcript from ~/.claude/projects, takes the cross-family reviewer from the `trail reviewer` role, and links unslop and itself by path.

skills/show-me-your-work/scripts/log.sh.why: Writes the header exactly once when calls race on a new log (a hard link instead of an append), and neutralises a spreadsheet formula that follows leading spaces.

skills/statechart/scripts/test/cli.test..why: realpathSync on the mkdtemp links dir, so the test passes on macOS where os.tmpdir() is a /var -> /private/var symlink.

skills/swarm/SKILL.md.why: Spawns general-purpose Agent workers, and Codex workers as background codex-run.sh commands, each writer in its own worktree instead of Cursor cloud VMs, splits easy and judgment pieces across the `swarm workers` and `swarm hard workers` roles, and respawns a dropped coverage worker once.

skills/teach/SKILL.md.why: Reads unslop, how, and why from their files before the first reply, since how and why are user-only.

skills/typescript-best-practices/SKILL.m.why: Reads principle-type-system-discipline from its file before any code, since that principle skill is user-only.

skills/flatpaper-mode/playbooks/bug-fix..why: Ports pstack-claude #438: a focused-fix exception that skips why and architect for a localized fix with a demonstrated cause, architect for contract changes inside one function, an independent reviewer for security and data-integrity invariants, and a publication-versus-runtime report.
